mode: actual possessed pawn; native MoveForward, StartSprint/StopSprint and Jump/StopJumping callbacks
setup: PIE-only clear pitch; cars/residents hidden with collision disabled; physical input disabled; native directional turn uses MoveRight; actual controller camera and HUD retained
captures: no stills; unpaused 1x native actions with selected timestamped graph/bone/camera observations
cadence_sampling: Selected observations at most 30 per world second; not a render FPS or fluidity measurement
not_checked: native C-key crew selection (covered separately by smoke_test)
exact likeness to the supplied photographs
pixel identity after BC7 GPU compression, lighting and postprocessing
rendered fluidity and real-time video acceptance
live city collision, crowds and co-op

pilot_rig.scope: generated body-only rig; static face and fingers

native_material_readback.scope: read only; native component materials were not repaired by this motion fixture

checks.scope: selected native state and pose observations at 1x; no rendered fluidity or FPS acceptance
